title: A gradient border
summary: border-color cannot be a gradient, but two layered backgrounds with background-clip can fake one.
explanation: A border colour must be a single colour, so border: 2px solid linear-gradient(…) is invalid. The trick is to make the border transparent and paint the gradient underneath it.

The card has two background layers. The first is a plain white gradient clipped to padding-box: it fills the inside only. The second is the orange-to-pink gradient clipped to border-box: it fills everything, and it only shows through where the transparent border is.
Because it is one element, border-radius rounds both layers together, which the older trick of nesting two boxes struggles with.
tryThis: Change the border width to 6px: the gradient ring gets thicker.
Swap the order of the two background layers: the gradient now covers the whole card.
Change the white layer to #18181b and the text colour to white for a dark card.

children.text: The border is a gradient, rounded with the card.
